items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts using AI to generate posts criticizing a Taiwanese social media influencer and related US topics.

items.title: Operation “Wrong Number”: AI-assisted task scam
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts that likely originated in Cambodia and used AI to support scam workflows targeting people in the UK.

items.title: STORM-2035: Recidivist influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the likely Iran-linked STORM-2035 operation using AI to create influence content about US, UK, Irish, and Venezuelan politics.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了与伊朗关联的STORM-2035组织账号，该组织利用AI进行政治影响力活动。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于AI安全合规与滥用治理范畴，非模型技术本身的发展。

items.title: Operation “Uncle Spam”: US polarization influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned China-origin accounts using AI to generate US political content and research people, movements, and online communities.

items.title: Operation “High Five”: Philippines political comments
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts using AI to generate comments about Philippine politics and public officials across social platforms.

items.title: Operation “Helgoland Bite”: German-language influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Russia and used AI to generate German-language political content about Ukraine, NATO, and domestic issues.

items.title: Deceptive Employment Scheme: IT worker activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with suspected deceptive employment campaigns that used AI to develop materials for potentially fraudulent remote-job applications.

items.title: Operation “ScopeCreep”: Russian-speaking malware development
items.summary: OpenAI banned Russian-language accounts using AI to build malware, refine loaders, and troubleshoot cyber tooling.

items.title: Vixen and Keyhole Panda: China-linked cyber operations
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with threat actors publicly attributed to the PRC, using AI to support vulnerability research, scripting, translation, and operational troubleshooting.

items.title: Operation “VAGue Focus”: Social engineering and influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts using AI for social engineering, surveillance-themed research, and influence activity targeting critics.
